description: Return a list of US city suggestions (with state) for partial input. Use for city-field type-ahead, or to resolve a partial city name to its full name and state. For full street-address suggestions use sthan_autocomplete_address; for ZIP codes use sthan_autocomplete_zipcode. Read-only with no side effects. Requires a sthan.io API key in STHAN_API_KEY; each call counts toward your plan's rate limit (a free tier is available). On failure it returns an error message.

display_type.description: 0 = City, StateCode (e.g. 'San Francisco, CA'). 1 = City, State (e.g. 'San Francisco, California')

name: sthan_autocomplete_city
title: Autocomplete US City
